title: Fairytale Swan

outfit_card.silhouette: A sculpted strapless corseted bodice flaring into a voluminous, multi-tiered tulle ballgown skirt with an asymmetrical layered overskirt, paired with sheer fitted sleeves and a sweeping feathered train.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A crystalline swan-wing tiara with delicate feather motifs, cascading pearl drop chains, and a sheer illusion veil.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless blush corset bodice with a sweetheart neckline, textured with vertical pleats and adorned with a frosty white feather-embellished sweetheart overlay, sheer white lace opera gloves, and a pearl choker necklace.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A layered ballgown skirt featuring a pleated dusty pink tulle base, a textured white feather-and-tulle peplum overskirt with silver embroidered scalloped edges, and a trailing sheer white tulle train.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating white swan feathers, crystalline wing-shaped back attachments, and a spark-laden magical trailing scarf.
